# Daily Bread

> Daily Bread is a free daily email newsletter that delivers a short Bible
> passage, a brief reflection, and a short prayer each morning. It is built
> for people who want a consistent, ad-free spiritual practice without
> installing another app — everything arrives directly in the subscriber's
> inbox.

## What it is
- A daily (or user-chosen frequency) devotional email: Scripture + reflection + prayer.
- Free to subscribe, no account required beyond name and email.
- Optional "Spiritual Journey" multi-day email series on specific topics.
- Subscribers can update preferences or unsubscribe at any time via a personal profile link.

## Who it's for
People seeking a brief, honest daily spiritual practice — Christians and
seekers who want Scripture-centered content without social feeds, ads, or
pressure to perform a "streak."

## Key facts
- Format: email newsletter.
- Cost: free.
- Sign-up: name + email on the landing page.
- Cadence: daily, chosen by the subscriber.
- Content: Scripture reference, short message/reflection, and a prayer; some
  emails include an "encouragement" note and a suggested Bible reading.
- Account access: subscribers manage preferences through a private magic-link
  profile page — no password required.

## Pages
- [Homepage](https://dailybread.app/): overview, the daily rhythm, and signup form.

## Contact
For questions about Daily Bread, use the sign-up form on the homepage.
